exposure: Oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) performed at term pregnancy
outcome: Mean glucose in the glucose challenge test
cohort: Pregnant women with a normal 50 g glucose challenge test who also had an oral glucose tolerance test at or after 37 weeks of gestation.
finding: A pathological OGTT performed at term was unable to identify women at risk for impaired glucose metabolism-related obstetric complications.
gest_age: At or after 37 weeks of gestation
birth_weight: Mentioned in the context of macrosomia
